questions.answer: gcd use karke fraction ko simplify karte hain taake numerator aur denominator ko smallest form mein la saken. Agar hum divide nahi karenge, to 2/4 aur 1/2 different honge, lekin simplify karne se dono same ho jate hain.
questions.feedback: Excellent explanation of why simplification is necessary for equality checks.
questions.prompt: In your `__init__`, what does `common = gcd(num, den)` do, and why is it necessary to use it for both `self.num` and `self.den`?

questions.answer: Yeh line check karti hai ke denominator zero toh nahi hai, kyunke maths mein zero se divide karna impossible hota hai. Agar user zero dega toh program error de dega warna math logic kharab ho jayegi.
questions.feedback: Correct identification of the need for error handling in mathematical operations.

questions.answer: Multiplication ke liye main __mul__ magic method use karunga. Is mein numerator ko numerator se aur denominator ko denominator se multiply karke naya Fraction return kar denge.
